answer: Timed Radio Pulse Registry. Each agent identity must emit a radio pulse with a hardware-timestamped nonce from a registered transmitter site, and the registry only accepts one live identity per physical transmitter per epoch. Relay the pulse across two independent receivers; the timing ripple between them must match the claimed site coordinates within tolerance. An attacker needs a separate transmitter and site for every fake identity, and a single operator cannot fake the ripple without physically placing hardware on that ledge.
